description: Prayer times during a flight, worked out along the route at cruising altitude: which prayers fall in the air (in both airports' local time), which before departure and after arrival, and the Qibla relative to the aircraft's nose. On flights to Jeddah, also the miqat where pilgrims intending Hajj or Umrah must be in ihram. Flights up to 20 hours. The flight is either a flight number with its departure date (the airline's scheduled airports and times, looked up here), or the airports and local times. With a flight number, also the airline's halal meal policy.

arrival_local.description: Arrival in the arrival airport's local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

asr.description: Asr juristic method. Default: Hanafi when departing from Pakistan, India, Bangladesh or Afghanistan, else Shafii.

departure_local.description: Departure in the departure airport's local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

flight_date.description: Departure date at the departure airport, YYYY-MM-DD, with flight_number.

flight_number.description: Flight number, for example "SQ308". With flight_date, the airports and times are looked up; a flight with a stop is one leg at a time (from_airport or to_airport picks it).

from_airport.description: Departure airport: IATA code ("SIN") or name.

method.description: Calculation method id from list_calculation_methods. Default: the method of the departure country's Islamic authority, else Muslim World League.

to_airport.description: Arrival airport: IATA code ("LHR") or name.

name: get_inflight_prayer_times
title: In-flight prayer times
